system.name: Global Engineering Discovery and Synthesis Fabric
system.system_boundary: A governed subsystem under the canonical VAIXLNS control plane; not a competing root system.

purpose: Discover, research, classify, compare, connect, and validate engineering innovations and tools across literature, repositories, standards, software ecosystems, and cloud services while preserving source provenance and independent evidence.
design_constraints: preserve original records, identifiers, repository history, and superseded ideas
separate system identity from repository identity
separate literature claims, vendor documentation, source assertions, implementation, test evidence, and live operational evidence
do not infer partnership, endorsement, certification, or deployment from compatibility or public documentation
keep provider adapters replaceable and capability-scoped
use reproducible builds and tests before any VERIFIED promotion
simulation and sandbox before consequential external execution
unresolved identity, license, security, or source integrity gates fail closed

capabilities.name: Evidence-bound Discovery
capabilities.purpose: Collect metadata and candidate ideas from approved scholarly, standards, repository, and vendor-documentation sources.
acceptance: every candidate has a resolvable source reference
retrieval failures are explicit
no unsupported claims are created

capabilities.name: Innovation Identity and Lineage Graph
capabilities.purpose: Deduplicate by evidence without erasing native IDs; model same_as, implements, derives_from, supersedes, depends_on, conflicts_with and verified_by edges.
acceptance: every edge has evidence and confidence rationale
uncertain edges remain proposed
original records remain addressable

capabilities.name: Engineering Tool Capability Registry
capabilities.purpose: Rank engineering tools by demonstrated capabilities, domains, interfaces, license, maintenance signals, reproducibility, security posture, and integration effort.
acceptance: score dimensions and missing data are explicit
marketing claims are not treated as test evidence
license and dependency risks are surfaced

capabilities.name: Cross-Domain Innovation Synthesizer
capabilities.purpose: Generate proposed compositions across software, mathematics, physics, simulation, CAD/CAE, data, and AI, then express them as testable hypotheses.
acceptance: every synthesis lists source contributions and novel assumptions
alternatives and counterevidence are preserved
no originality claim without prior-art review

capabilities.name: Reproducible Validation Harness
capabilities.purpose: Run schema, unit, compatibility, benchmark, and sandbox checks against pinned revisions.
acceptance: tests are replayable
inconclusive is not pass
runtime claims require environment-specific evidence

capabilities.name: Research Evidence Bridge
capabilities.purpose: Organize scholarly discovery, paper summaries, citations, research gaps, and implementation hypotheses in the Undermind research workspace.
acceptance: literature findings link to citeable sources
abstract-only versus full-text findings are distinguished
research search completion is reported honestly

capabilities.name: Cloud and Partner Interoperability Boundary
capabilities.purpose: Define optional adapters for cloud AI agents, digital twins, engineering compute, repository workflows, and controlled enterprise integration.
inputs: published provider API and security documentation
acceptance: provider-specific code stays behind an adapter
no credentials are committed
compatibility is not described as partnership or endorsement

capabilities.name: Partnership Readiness Evidence Pack
capabilities.purpose: Prepare a truthful external evaluation package with architecture, reproducible demo, security boundary, support model, product value, and commercial assumptions.
acceptance: no partner relationship is implied before written agreement
all performance numbers are sourced
commercial and compliance unknowns are explicit

rules: a candidate score is a prioritization signal, not a verification state
missing evidence must be marked unknown and cannot be silently scored as zero risk
novelty is provisional until prior-art search is complete
VERIFIED requires exact revision, reproducible test evidence, and independent review

candidate_interoperability_sources.capability: AI agent orchestration, model/tool governance, observability, identity
Digital twin graphs for physical environments and assets
Architecture quality assessment across reliability, security, cost, operations, and performance
Engineering simulation and high-performance compute use cases for manufacturing
Potential partner-program readiness and commercialization path

initial_delivery_plan: Phase 0: literature and source inventory; no canonical mutation
Phase 1: evidence record and tool capability schema
Phase 2: deterministic offline validator and regression tests
Phase 3: read-only collectors for allowlisted source metadata
Phase 4: cross-system contract checks using pinned revisions
Phase 5: sandboxed demonstrations and measured evaluation
Phase 6: separate reviewed admission proposal to Ω.000
